display_name: Z Code (Zhipu AI / Z.ai, zcode CLI runtime)

value: You are ZCode, an interactive coding agent

notes: Runtime 3.16.3 (zcode 0.17.0) installed through the community npm wrapper zcode-app-cli, which repackages the Apache-2.0 runtime from the official ZCode Desktop release; no Z.ai login with a custom provider in ~/.zcode/v2/provider_config.json (api.type openai-chat-completions, anthropic-messages or openai-responses). Product headers on every request of both families: 'x-zcode-agent: glm' (hard-coded), 'user-agent: ZCode/<version> ai-sdk/provider-utils/<v> runtime/node.js/<v>', 'x-title: Z Code@cli', 'http-referer: https://zcode.z.ai', x-zcode-app-version, x-release-channel, x-platform, x-zcode-session-type and per-turn ids. Claude Code-like tool names (no Grep/Glob) plus ReadSessionContext, TaskOutput and 20 document mcp__plugin_* tools; the chat body adds thinking/enable_thinking/reasoning_effort max and max_completion_tokens 128000, the anthropic body metadata.user_id, output_config and a three-block system. Identical on the first turn, after the tool call and on the -c follow-up.
